turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please complete the following checks: Inspect the encoder scale for scratches, oil, or coolant deposits. Check the read head mounting for looseness or impact damage. Inspect the cable and connector for chafing or corrosion.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the encoder scale for scratches, oil, or coolant deposits. 2. Check the read head mounting for looseness or impact damage. 3. Inspect the cable and connector for chafing or corrosion.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Visual inspection complete. The encoder scale looks clean, read head is mounted securely, and the cable and connector show no visible damage.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the encoder scale for scratches, oil, or coolant deposits. 2. Check the read head mounting for looseness or impact damage. 3. Inspect the cable and connector for chafing or corrosion.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is there physical damage to the encoder strip or read head?

ground_truth.node_text: Physical damage to encoder strip or read head?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No physical damage detected on either component.

ground_truth.node_text: Physical damage to encoder strip or read head?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the signal quality clean with no dropouts in the waveform?

ground_truth.node_text: Signal quality: clean waveform, no dropouts?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, both A and B channels are producing clean square waves with proper phase separation and no missing pulses.

ground_truth.node_text: Signal quality: clean waveform, no dropouts?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Was the reference mark found during the homing cycle?

ground_truth.node_text: Reference mark found during homing cycle?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The axis didn't locate the reference mark properly. The home offset value doesn't match what's stored in the parameter table.

ground_truth.node_text: Reference mark found during homing cycle?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reteach the home offset and adjust the reference mark position.

ground_truth.node_text: Reteach home offset, adjust reference mark position

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Home offset has been retaught and the reference mark position is now adjusted.

ground_truth.node_text: Reteach home offset, adjust reference mark position

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Command the axis to move to each of ten programmed reference positions distributed across the full travel, pausing two seconds at each point. At each position, record the encoder feedback value and the commanded position from the controller display, then calculate the maximum positioning error.

ground_truth.node_text: Command the axis to move to each of ten programmed reference positions distributed across the full travel, pausing two seconds at each point. At each position, record the encoder feedback value and the commanded position from the controller display. Calculate the maximum positioning error across the grid and compare against the axis accuracy specification.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All ten reference positions have been tested and the data recorded. Maximum positioning error has been calculated.

ground_truth.node_text: Command the axis to move to each of ten programmed reference positions distributed across the full travel, pausing two seconds at each point. At each position, record the encoder feedback value and the commanded position from the controller display. Calculate the maximum positioning error across the grid and compare against the axis accuracy specification.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the position accuracy within tolerance at all test points?

ground_truth.node_text: Position accuracy within tolerance at all test points?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all test points are within the specified accuracy tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Position accuracy within tolerance at all test points?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the thermal compensation parameter active and correct?

ground_truth.node_text: Thermal compensation parameter active and correct?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The thermal compensation coefficient doesn't match the reference value for this machine.

ground_truth.node_text: Thermal compensation parameter active and correct?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Complete the following checks: Read the thermal compensation coefficient from the controller parameter screen, compare it against the reference value for this machine, and check whether the compensation model was modified since the last calibration.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Read the thermal compensation coefficient from the controller parameter screen. 2. Compare the stored coefficient against the reference value for this machine. 3. Check whether the compensation model was modified since the last calibration.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I'm seeing the thermal compensation coefficient is way outside the normal range, but the compensation model itself shows signs of firmware corruption - there's garbled text in the parameter fields that shouldn't be there.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Thermal compensation checks complete. I've verified the coefficient and confirmed the model status.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Read the thermal compensation coefficient from the controller parameter screen. 2. Compare the stored coefficient against the reference value for this machine. 3. Check whether the compensation model was modified since the last calibration.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Trace the encoder cable from the read head to the drive amplifier, checking for sharp bends, contact with rotating parts, or unsupported lengths. Confirm that strain relief clamps are tight and positioned within one hundred millimeters of each connector. Gently flex the cable at any suspected damage point while monitoring the encoder signal for glitches.

ground_truth.node_text: Trace the encoder cable from the read head to the drive amplifier, checking for sharp bends at conduit entries, contact with rotating parts, or unsupported lengths that can flex during high speed movement. Confirm that strain relief clamps are tight and positioned within 100 millimetres of each connector. Gently flex the cable at any suspected damage point while monitoring the encoder signal for glitches.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Cable routing inspection complete. I've checked the entire run and tested for signal glitches during flexing.

ground_truth.node_text: Trace the encoder cable from the read head to the drive amplifier, checking for sharp bends at conduit entries, contact with rotating parts, or unsupported lengths that can flex during high speed movement. Confirm that strain relief clamps are tight and positioned within 100 millimetres of each connector. Gently flex the cable at any suspected damage point while monitoring the encoder signal for glitches.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the cable condition and routing acceptable?

ground_truth.node_text: Cable condition and routing acceptable?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the cable is in good condition with proper routing and all strain relief clamps are secure.

ground_truth.node_text: Cable condition and routing acceptable?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Did the final five point position verification cycle pass?

ground_truth.node_text: Final 5 point position verification cycle passed?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all five verification points passed successfully.

ground_truth.node_text: Final 5 point position verification cycle passed?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Log the encoder service data and update the maintenance record.

ground_truth.node_text: Log encoder service data and update maintenance record

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I'm seeing intermittent voltage spikes on the encoder's shield ground connection that aren't mentioned anywhere in this procedure. Should I be concerned about that?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Service data has been logged and the maintenance record is updated.

ground_truth.node_text: Log encoder service data and update maintenance record

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Encoder diagnostic procedure complete. The system is verified and ready for operation.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Understood, procedure complete.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete
